name: tiktokshopglobalselling.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But certain ARIA roles must be contained by particular parents.
lesson: Use native HTML elements first. When you use ARIA roles, nest them the way the role requires.
summary: www.tiktokshopglobalselling.com scores 61 out of 100 (D). 8 checks fail now, 33 are at risk, and 18 pass. Fix first: certain ARIA roles must be contained by particular parents.

fix.title: Certain ARIA roles must be contained by particular parents
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 5 elements on /zh-cn, for example #arco-tabs-0-tab-0 and #arco-tabs-0-tab-1. Impact: critical.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 40 elements on /zh-cn, /zh-cn/newsroom/detail/e30d8ab3-0a29-4206-ad79-687164422f21, /zh-cn/newsroom/detail/a394a23a-b262-47d1-8799-0f515890fd15, for example .pc-header-btn-primary and…
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: The start page does not declare its language
fix.evidence: Screen readers pick the wrong voice and browsers offer the wrong translation.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: ARIA attributes must conform to valid values
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 1 element on /zh-cn, for example #arco-tabs-1-tab-0. Impact: critical.

fix.title: 16 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".
